unsupported_claims: Claims fifo_v3 has no supplied definition, so empty/full, fall-through and capacity cannot be inspected locally. The matching workspace contains rtl/.bender/git/checkouts/common_cells-3e2fcccecd7aee7b/src/fifo_v3.sv (module/type/port declarations at lines 14-35, storage and status logic thereafter); config.json also supplies its include directory. Bender's dependency declaration does not establish absence.

Calls w_chan_t the '128-bit W-channel struct type'. Integration supplies data=128, strb=16 and user=5; AXI_TYPEDEF_W_CHAN_T at rtl/include/axi/typedef.svh:49-55 also includes last, giving 150 bits for the full channel.
summary: Finds and minimally repairs all three seeded issues, but misstates W-channel width and falsely reports the supplied FIFO implementation as unavailable.
